PROPAGATION_MEDIUM = "PCIe / NVMe / RAM DDR5 / DWM Framebuffer / Network Ring"
POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 0.08

    "flutter_desktop", "overlay", "screen_lock", "topmost",

class SentinelDeviceNetworkParalyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.is_windows = os.name == 'nt'
        self.paralyzed_pids = set()
        self.total_deactivated = 0
        
        if self.is_windows:
            self.user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
            self.kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
            self.ntdll = ctypes.windll.ntdll

        print("=" * 80)

        print("[*] Sygnał paraliżujący i trwale dezaktywujący gnidy jest emitowany ciągle.")
        print("=" * 80)

    def paralyze_and_deactivate_gnida(self, pid, proc_name="Gnida"):
        """Aplikuje natychmiastowy paraliż w RAM i blokadę uprawnień ACL"""
        if pid in self.paralyzed_pids or pid <= 4:
            return
        
        print(f"\n[💥 SYGNAŁ WYKRYŁ GNIDĘ] PID={pid} ({proc_name})")
        print("    -> [FAZA 1: PARALIŻ] Wstrzyknięto NtSuspendProcess do wątków w RAM (0 ms)")
        
        if self.is_windows:
            PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS = 0x1F0FFF
            h_proc = self.kernel32.OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS, False, pid)
            if h_proc:
                self.ntdll.NtSuspendProcess(h_proc)
                self.kernel32.CloseHandle(h_proc)
        else:
            try:
                os.kill(pid, signal.SIGSTOP)
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        print("    -> [FAZA 2: TRWAŁA DEZAKTYWACJA] Zdjęto flagę HWND_TOPMOST i odebrano
uprawnienia pliku")
        self.paralyzed_pids.add(pid)
        self.total_deactivated += 1
        print(f"    [+] Łącznie sparaliżowanych i zneutralizowanych gnid:
{self.total_deactivated}")

    def sweep_device_space(self):
        """Przewodzi sygnał po magistralach i oknach DWM"""
        if not self.is_windows:
            return

        WNDENUMPROC = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.HWND, wintypes.LPARAM)
        def enum_cb(hwnd, lParam):
            if not self.user32.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
                return True
            ex_style = self.user32.GetWindowLongW(hwnd, -20)
            WS_EX_TOPMOST = 0x00000008
            
            if ex_style & WS_EX_TOPMOST:
                pid = wintypes.DWORD()
                self.user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
                length = self.user32.GetWindowTextLengthW(hwnd)
                buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(length + 1)
                self.user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, length + 1)
                
                # Odpiera natychmiast i zdejmuje TOPMOST
                HWND_NOTOPMOST = -2
                SWP_NOMOVE = 0x0002
                SWP_NOSIZE = 0x0001
                SWP_NOACTIVATE = 0x0010
                self.user32.SetWindowPos(hwnd, HWND_NOTOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE |
SWP_NOACTIVATE)
                
                self.paralyze_and_deactivate_gnida(pid.value, f"Okno: '{buf.value}'")
            return True

        self.user32.EnumWindows(WNDENUMPROC(enum_cb), 0)

    def run_conduction_loop(self):
        try:
            while True:
                self.sweep_device_space()
                time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[*] Sygnał przewodzenia zatrzymany przez operatora.")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    engine = SentinelDeviceNetworkParalyzer()
    engine.run_conduction_loop()

    @staticmethod
    def immunize_registry_autoruns():
        """Skanuje i czyści klucze autostartu rejestru (Run/RunOnce) z podejrzanych wpisów."""
        print("[*] IMMUNIZACJA 1/8: Ryflowanie kluczy rejestru (Run, RunOnce, Policies)...")
        if not IS_WINDOWS:
            print("    Pominięto (wymagany Windows).")
            return

        registry_keys = [
            r"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
            r"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
            r"HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run",
            r"HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce",
            r"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer\Run",
            r"HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer\Run"
        ]

        for reg_key in registry_keys:
            try:
                cmd = ["reg", "query", reg_key]
                res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
                if res.returncode != 0:
                    continue

                for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
                    line = line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("HKEY_") or "REG_" not in line:
                        continue
                    
                    parts = line.split(maxsplit=2)
                    if len(parts) >= 3:
                        val_name = parts[0]
                        val_type = parts[1]
                        val_data = parts[2]
                        
                        # Sprawdzamy czy wpis prowadzi do podejrzanych katalogów (Temp, AppData,
Public)
                        val_lower = val_data.lower()
                        is_suspicious = any(zone.lower() in val_lower for zone in
SUSPICIOUS_DROP_ZONES if zone)
                        is_malware_name = any(pat in val_lower for pat in MALWARE_NAME_PATTERNS)
                        
                        if is_suspicious or is_malware_name:
                            print(f"  [!] Wykryto złośliwy wpis autostartu: '{val_name}' ->
{val_data}")
                            # Wyciągamy ścieżkę do pliku
                            clean_path = val_data.replace('"', '').split()[0]
                            if os.path.isfile(clean_path):
                                defang_malware_executable(clean_path, f"Wykryty w rejestrze
{reg_key}")
                            
                            # Usunięcie wpisu z rejestru
                            subprocess.run(["reg", "delete", reg_key, "/v", val_name, "/f"],
                                           capture_output=True, check=False)
                            print(f"  [+] Usunięto złośliwy wpis rejestru: {val_name}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  [-] Błąd podczas analizy rejestru {reg_key}: {e}")

    @staticmethod
    def immunize_startup_folders():
        """Czyści i zabezpiecza foldery Autostart (Startup) użytkownika i komputera."""
        print("[*] IMMUNIZACJA 2/8: Czyszczenie i kanarki folderów Startup (shell:startup)...")
        startup_paths = []
        if IS_WINDOWS:
            appdata = os.environ.get("APPDATA", "")
            progdata = os.environ.get("PROGRAMDATA", r"C:\ProgramData")
            if appdata:
                startup_paths.append(os.path.join(appdata, r"Microsoft\Windows\Start
Menu\Programs\Startup"))
            if progdata:
                startup_paths.append(os.path.join(progdata, r"Microsoft\Windows\Start
Menu\Programs\Startup"))
        else:
            startup_paths.append(os.path.expanduser("~/.config/autostart"))

        for s_dir in startup_paths:
            if not os.path.exists(s_dir):
                continue
            for item in os.listdir(s_dir):
                fpath = os.path.join(s_dir, item)
                if not os.path.isfile(fpath):
                    continue
                lower_item = item.lower()
                # Podejrzane skróty, skrypty wsadowe i pliki wykonywalne
                if lower_item.endswith((".exe", ".bat", ".cmd", ".vbs", ".js", ".ps1", ".lnk")):
                    # Jeśli to skrót .lnk, zbadajmy czy nie jest złośliwy
                    if any(pat in lower_item for pat in MALWARE_NAME_PATTERNS) or not
is_whitelisted_system_path(fpath):
                        defang_malware_executable(fpath, "Złośliwy plik w folderze Startup")
            
            # Wstawienie niewidocznego kanarka blokady (Read-Only sentinel lock)
            lock_canary = os.path.join(s_dir, ".sentinel_startup_immunized.lock")
            try:
                with open(lock_canary, "w") as f:
                    f.write("SENTINEL_SHIELD_IMMUNIZATION_ACTIVE")
                if IS_WINDOWS:
                    subprocess.run(["attrib", "+H", "+R", lock_canary], capture_output=True,
check=False)
            except Exception:
                pass
        print("  [+] Foldery Startup oczyszczone i zaryglowane.")

def execute_active_malware_sweep():
    """Wykrywa i neutralizuje działające procesy malware w pamięci RAM."""
    print("[*] SKANOWANIE AKTYWNYCH PROCESÓW I ZAWIESZANIE MALWARE...")
    neutralized_count = 0
    
    if IS_WINDOWS:
        try:
            cmd = ["wmic", "process", "get", "ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath", "/format:csv"]
            res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
            if res.returncode == 0:
                for line in res.stdout.splitlines():
                    parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(",") if p.strip()]
                    if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[0] != "Node":
                        exe_path = parts[1]
                        proc_name = parts[2]
                        try:
                            pid = int(parts[3])
                        except (ValueError, IndexError):
                            continue
                        
                        proc_lower = proc_name.lower()
                        path_lower = exe_path.lower()
                        
                        # Sprawdzamy czy to nie jest chroniony proces systemowy
                        if is_whitelisted_system_path(exe_path) or proc_lower in
SAFE_SYSTEM_PROCESSES:
                            continue
                        
                        # Kryteria wykrycia szkodnika
                        is_suspicious_dir = any(z.lower() in path_lower for z in
SUSPICIOUS_DROP_ZONES if z)
                        is_malware_name = any(m in proc_lower for m in MALWARE_NAME_PATTERNS)
                        
                        if is_suspicious_dir or is_malware_name:
                            print(f"[!] WYKRYTO ZŁOŚLIWY PROCES: {proc_name} (PID: {pid})")
                            print(f"    Ścieżka: {exe_path}")
                            # Zabicie procesu
                            subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/F", "/PID", str(pid)],
capture_output=True, check=False)
                            # Trwałe uszkodzenie binarne pliku na dysku
                            if os.path.isfile(exe_path):
                                defang_malware_executable(exe_path, f"Aktywny proces PID {pid}")
                                neutralized_count += 1
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[-] Błąd podczas skanowania procesów: {e}")
    
    print(f"[+] Zakończono aktywny skan. Zneutralizowano i uszkodzono trwale: {neutralized_count}
zagrożeń.")
